verbose.description: Enable verbose output (-v). Use multiple times for more verbosity, but here we represent it as a single flag for config simplicity.

findall.description: Find all WAFs, do not stop testing on the first one (-a).

noredirect.description: Do not follow redirections given by 3xx responses (-r).

output_file.description: Write output to csv, json or text file depending on file extension. For stdout, specify empty string or '-'. (-o)

output_format.description: Force output format to csv, json or text. (-f)

proxy.description: Use an HTTP proxy to perform requests. Example: http://hostname:8080, socks5://hostname:1080. (-p)

timeout.description: Set the timeout for the requests in seconds. (-T)

input_targets.description: List of URLs to test. Each item is a map with 'url' field containing the target URL.

input_file.description: Read targets from a file (-i). Input format can be csv, json or text. For csv and json, a 'url' column name or element is required.

headers_file.description: Pass custom headers (-H). File containing headers to overwrite default user-agent or add other headers.

specific_waf.description: Test for one specific WAF product. (--test=WAF)
